products.name: AV Pack Verification
products.product: A focused live event AV equipment pack verification workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small live-event audio, video, lighting, and staging companies
products.problem: System design, substitutions, cables, adapters, spares, firmware context, cases, and truck positions are translated into pull sheets manually.
products.valueProposition: Turns live event AV equipment pack verification into a visible operating queue so every deployed AV package is independently checked against the current show design and exception list.
products.topic: live event AV equipment pack verification
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets live event AV equipment pack verification software, live event AV equipment pack verification tracker, live event AV equipment pack verification template, and live event AV equipment pack verification checklist searches.
